# Pull request

## What does this PR do?
A short summary of the change and why.

## How to test
Describe how to verify the change. Include the CLI self-test commands you ran.

- [ ] Build succeeds: `./build.sh`
- [ ] CLI self-tests pass (German and English)
- [ ] No telemetry, network calls, or API keys were added (local-first contract)
- [ ] Code, comments, and commit messages are in English; no emojis or em-dashes
- [ ] New engines (if any) are behind the `Transcriber` protocol and registered in
      `TranscriberRegistry`

## Screenshots
If the change touches UI or layout, attach light and dark mode screenshots of the
menu bar panel and the Settings window.
